sentences: On a snowy slope, one pine stands bolt upright while a second, its roots laid bare, leans across in front of it.
The straight tree's branches break off at sharp right angles, and angular rocks guard the base of its trunk.
Yi In-sang never painted the snow at all.
He left the tops of the rocks and branches as bare paper and laid a pale ink wash over the sky, so the white seems to settle on its own.
Dry, scratchy needles and an ink tone with no dark accents give the scene its cold, clear air.
Born into a branch of a noble family barred from high office, Yi rose no higher than a county magistrate, yet he was known as a scholar of unbending principle.
A pine that stays green through winter was his portrait of that ideal.
